_comment: The one list of profile import sources. Read by src/modules/profile/importDraft.js, scripts/run-profile-import.js and python/profile_import/text_parser.py; tests/js/importSources.test.js checks they agree. input: 'text' = the text route receives text (a PDF is read to text in the browser); 'bytes' = the file route receives the file's bytes and the server reads it. reader: 'text' = the text parser reads (after any conversion to text), 'json' = the JSON Resume mapper.
